checklist: In the CORE service app run the Network Setup Wizard (RTU MENU > NETWORK INTEGRATION), pick BACnet IP or BACnet MS/TP and choose Room Sensor control mode.

On BACnet IP the device instance defaults to the last IP octet and UDP port 47808 cannot be changed; on MS/TP use consecutive MACs from 1, set the baud (default 38.4k) and set Max_Master to the highest MAC on the trunk.
Discover the device (default name Lennox_CORE_2) and confirm MV 310 (Mode of Operation) reads 4 = Room sensor.
Read AI 232 (Unit Status), AI 239 (Space Temperature), AI 240 (Discharge Air Temperature) and AI 242 (Local Outside Air Temperature) and check they make sense.
If the BMS supplies space temperature, write AO 113 (Space Temperature Input) within 5 minutes of start-up, since the unit sits in a no-run mode until it arrives, and check AI 239 follows.
Write AO 104 (Occupancy Scheduler Control) = 0 and AV 130-133 with heating below cooling by the deadband (Parameter 152, default 3 °F), then confirm AI 241 and AI 252 follow.
Test AO 101 (Application Mode Control) = 6 and confirm AI 232 reads 6 = Off, then write 0 to return the unit to auto.
Set the BMS to rewrite every control point at least every 5 minutes (Lennox recommends 2) and after any controller reset, because commands are not stored.
Map CSV 302 (Alarm Log) for alarms instead of the legacy AI 253-264 objects.
